Hi Maya — thanks for the heads up. Short answer: yes, we can provision a temporary PO for activation, but we need procurement + finance to approve a provisional spend cap until tax docs are received.

Monica / David — can procurement issue a temporary PO number and lock a provisional spend cap (requested by vendor: up to $50,000) while we wait for W-9 and corrected SKU quantities? Important notes:
- Temp PO must be flagged in the ledger as "TEMP - pending tax" so it doesn't flow into permanent commitments.
- Line items should be held to per-SKU approval; vendor flagged ELR-102 quantity mismatch — please validate and ask vendor to provide corrected CSV.
- If procurement sets a provisional cap, finance approval required for anything over $35k.

Maya — please send the corrected W-9 and revised line-items CSV when ready. Once procurement creates the temp PO, we'll share the stub and next steps for invoicing.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Monica / Markus — reviewed the provisional PO and the vendor documents. Finance is OK to increase the provisional spend cap to $45,000 to cover the initial provisioning and first-cycle invoices, provided the vendor submits the corrected invoice referencing the TEMP-20261124-8742 PO and we mark the ledger entry as provisional until final PO reissue. Please do the following:

1) Re-issue TEMP-20261124-8742 with an updated provisional cap of $45,000 and add a note in the PO header: "Provisional — final PO pending tax verification. Do not auto-renew commitments."
2) Apply a ledger tag: PROC_TEMP / HOLD_TAX / FIN_REVIEW so downstream reporting excludes this from committed spend until cleared.
3) Once procurement receives the invoice against the temp PO, finance will clear up to $45k; any additional amount will be blocked pending final PO.
4) After you confirm vendor invoice submission, procurement to open a final PO (PO-20261127-XXXX) and reissue with corrected quantities (ELR-102 qty=10). Attach redline for audit.

Attached: redline_po_8742.pdf (suggested header insertion and quantity correction instructions).

I'll sign off once procurement confirms the reissue and if the vendor references the temp PO on their invoice.

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Finance Operations
